lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a structured grid pattern, forming roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 spots across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of luminance maxima to create a matrix of anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and sharp shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 8 to 12 high-luminance blobs localized within its macro-mask boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance dark shapes (likely remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region and near the anterior base of the first dorsal fin.
